rules.title: Candy Land
rules.description: Two to four players race along the candy path to the Castle. On your turn, click the deck: a color card moves your pawn to the next space of that color, a double card to the second one, and a picture card straight to its picture's space, forward or back. Landing exactly on the Rainbow Trail or the Gumdrop Pass takes a shortcut; landing on Licorice loses your next turn. No choices, all luck: made for small children.
how_to_play: Be the first to move your pawn along the candy path from Start (bottom left) to the Castle. The path snakes up the board, row by row.
- Click the deck to draw a card. Your pawn moves by itself.
- A color card moves you to the next space of that color; a double card to the second one.
- A picture card (Peppermint, Gingerbread, Gumdrop, Peanut, Lollipop, Frost) sends you straight to its pink space, even if that's backwards.
- Land exactly on Trail or Pass and you take a shortcut further up the path.
- Land on Licorice and you miss your next turn.
- There are no choices to make: it's all in the cards.

then: log('%s is stuck on Licorice, and loses a turn' % [name_of(player)])

conditions.path_space: space_at(path, index % 12 + 1 if (index / 12) % 2 == 0 else 12 - index % 12, 10 - index / 12)
conditions.color_at: 'Pink' if index in picture_spaces else lookup(colors, (index - 1) % 6)
